title: Ranglar, kiyim va do‘konda xarid
goal_uz: Dars oxirida ranglarni va kiyim nomlarini ishlatib nima kiyib turganingizni aytasiz, this/that/these/those ni to‘g‘ri tanlaysiz hamda do‘konda narx, o‘lcham so‘rab, kiyib ko‘rib sotib olasiz.

scenes.title: Ranglar, kiyim va do‘kon
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! O‘n ikkinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan darsda shaharda yo‘l so‘rashni va yo‘l tushuntirishni o‘rgandik. Bugun kundalik hayotda juda kerak bo‘ladigan mavzu: ranglar, kiyim nomlari va do‘konda xarid qilish. Dars oxirida nima kiyib turganingizni ingliz tilida aytib bera olasiz, narxni, o‘lchamni so‘rab, kurtkani kiyib ko‘rib sotib olasiz.
scenes.say: Hello again! Today we will learn colours and clothes, and we will go shopping in English.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! Bugun ranglar va kiyimlarni o‘rganamiz va ingliz tilida xarid qilamiz.

scenes.title: Birinchi ranglar
scenes.say_native: Eng kerakli oltita rangdan boshlaymiz. Red — qizil. Blue — ko‘k. Green — yashil. Yellow — sariq. Black — qora. White — oq. Diqqat qiling: o‘zbekchada “ko‘k” ham osmon rangi, ham yashilga yaqin rang uchun ishlatiladi, inglizchada esa blue va green aniq ajratiladi. Blue faqat osmon, dengiz rangi, green esa o‘t va barg rangi.
scenes.say: Red, blue, green, yellow, black, white. The sky is blue. The grass is green.
scenes.say_uz: Qizil, ko‘k, yashil, sariq, qora, oq. Osmon ko‘k. O‘t yashil.

scenes.title: Yana beshta rang
scenes.say_native: Yana beshta rang. Grey — kulrang. Brown — jigarrang. Pink — pushti. Orange — apelsin rangi, ya’ni to‘q sariq, va bu so‘z meva nomi bilan bir xil. Purple — binafsha. Eslatma: ranglarning “color” deb yozilishi amerikacha, britancha yozuv esa “colour”. Ikkalasi ham to‘g‘ri, lekin biz bu kursda britancha shaklni ishlatamiz. Grey ham britancha, amerikaliklar odatda gray deb yozadi.
scenes.say: Grey, brown, pink, orange, purple. In British English we write colour. In American English: color.
scenes.say_uz: Kulrang, jigarrang, pushti, to‘q sariq, binafsha. Britancha yozuvda colour, amerikachada color.

scenes.title: Rangni toping
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Men to‘rtta narsani aytaman, siz ularning rangini inglizcha ayting. Birinchisi banan. Ikkinchisi qor. Uchinchisi pomidor. To‘rtinchisi o‘t. Har biriga to‘liq jumla tuzishga harakat qiling: “A banana is…”.
scenes.say: What colour is a banana? What colour is snow? What colour is a tomato? What colour is grass?
scenes.say_uz: Banan qanday rangda? Qor qanday rangda? Pomidor qanday rangda? O‘t qanday rangda?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Banan sariq: a banana is yellow. Qor oq: snow is white. Pomidor qizil: a tomato is red. O‘t yashil: grass is green. E’tibor bering, “What colour is it?” — bu rangni so‘rash uchun asosiy savol, ya’ni u qanday rangda? Javob esa “It’s” va rang nomidan iborat: It’s red.
scenes.say: A banana is yellow. Snow is white. A tomato is red. Grass is green.
scenes.say_uz: Banan sariq. Qor oq. Pomidor qizil. O‘t yashil.

scenes.title: Rang sifatdosh sifatida
board: It's red. / The jacket is red.
scenes.say_native: Rang so‘zi sifat, ya’ni adjective. Inglizchada sifat otdan oldin turadi: a red jacket, a black shirt. Bu o‘zbekchadagi tartibga o‘xshaydi: qizil kurtka. Lekin bir muhim qoida bor. Sifat ko‘plik qo‘shimchasini olmaydi va otga moslashmaydi. Ikkita qizil kurtka — two red jackets, bunda s faqat otda, rangda emas. Rang so‘zida hech qachon s bo‘lmaydi.
scenes.say: I have a red jacket. She has two red jackets. A blue bag. Three blue bags.
scenes.say_uz: Menda qizil kurtka bor. Uning ikkita qizil kurtkasi bor. Ko‘k sumka. Uchta ko‘k sumka.

scenes.title: Tartib va ko‘plik xatosi
scenes.say_native: Ikkita tipik xato. Birinchisi: rangni otdan keyin qo‘yish, masalan “a jacket red”. Bu ruscha yoki fransuzcha tartibga o‘xshaydi, lekin inglizchada rang doim otdan oldin keladi: a red jacket. Ikkinchi xato: ranglarga “s” qo‘shish, “two reds jackets”. To‘g‘risi: two red jackets. Faqat ot ko‘plikka o‘tadi. Agar gapda “is” bor bo‘lsa, rang gap oxirida turadi: the jacket is red.
scenes.say: Not: a jacket red. Say: a red jacket. Not: two reds jackets. Say: two red jackets.
scenes.say_uz: A jacket red emas. A red jacket deng. Two reds jackets emas. Two red jackets deng.

scenes.title: Inglizchaga o‘giring
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Mana to‘rtta ibora. Ularni inglizchaga o‘giring va rang so‘zi qayerda turishiga e’tibor bering. Birinchisi qora shim, buni hozircha “black trousers” deb aytsangiz bo‘ladi. Keyin oq ko‘ylak, ikkita ko‘k sumka va yashil kurtka. Baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: Black trousers. A white shirt. Two blue bags. A green jacket. Say them in English.
scenes.say_uz: Qora shim. Oq ko‘ylak. Ikkita ko‘k sumka. Yashil kurtka. Ularni inglizcha ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: black trousers, a white shirt, two blue bags, a green jacket. Qarang, har bir iborada rang otdan oldin turibdi va hech qaysi rang so‘zida s yo‘q. Trousers so‘zi o‘zi s bilan tugaydi, chunki shim ikki oyoqdan iborat, uni birozdan keyin alohida ko‘rib chiqamiz.
scenes.say: Black trousers. A white shirt. Two blue bags. A green jacket.
scenes.say_uz: Qora shim. Oq ko‘ylak. Ikkita ko‘k sumka. Yashil kurtka.

scenes.title: Ustki kiyimlar
scenes.say_native: Endi kiyim nomlari. Shirt — erkaklar ko‘ylagi, tugmali ko‘ylak. T-shirt — futbolka. Jumper — trikotaj kofta, amerikaliklar uni sweater deyishadi. Jacket — kurtka yoki pidjak. Coat — palto. Dress — ayollar ko‘ylagi, o‘zbekchada ham “ko‘ylak”, lekin inglizchada shirt va dress boshqa narsa. Skirt — yubka.
scenes.say: A shirt, a T-shirt, a jumper, a jacket, a coat, a dress, a skirt.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘ylak, futbolka, jemper, kurtka, palto, ayollar ko‘ylagi, yubka.

scenes.title: Pastki kiyim va aksessuarlar
scenes.say_native: Pastki kiyimlar: trousers — shim, jeans — jinsi, shorts — shortik. Oyoq kiyim: shoes — tufli, trainers — krossovka, boots — etik. Amerikaliklar krossovkani sneakers deyishadi. Va boshqalar: socks — paypoq, hat — shlyapa yoki bosh kiyim, scarf — sharf, gloves — qo‘lqop. Britaniyada shimni trousers deyishadi, AQShda esa pants. Britaniyada pants esa ichki kiyim, shuning uchun ehtiyot bo‘ling.
scenes.say: Trousers, jeans, shorts. Shoes, trainers, boots. Socks, a hat, a scarf, gloves.
scenes.say_uz: Shim, jinsi, shortik. Tufli, krossovka, etik. Paypoq, shlyapa, sharf, qo‘lqop.

scenes.title: A pair of
board: trousers, jeans, shorts, shoes, socks, gloves

examples.t: I need a pair of black shoes.
examples.uz: Menga bir juft qora tufli kerak.

scenes.say_native: Juft bo‘lgan kiyimlar inglizchada doim ko‘plikda: trousers, jeans, shorts, shoes, socks, gloves. Ularni sanash uchun “a pair of” ishlatamiz: a pair of jeans, two pairs of shoes. O‘zbekchada “bitta shim” deymiz, inglizchada esa a pair of trousers. Fe’l ham ko‘plikda keladi: my jeans are new. Bu yerda “is” aytish xato bo‘ladi, chunki jeans ko‘plik so‘z.
scenes.say: I need a pair of jeans. My jeans are new. These shoes are old. Two pairs of socks.
scenes.say_uz: Menga jinsi kerak. Mening jinsim yangi. Bu tuflilar eski. Ikki juft paypoq.

scenes.title: A trousers — xato
board: ✓ a pair of trousers / my jeans are
✓ a pair of shoes / some shoes
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida “shim” birlikda: bitta shim, u eski. Shuning uchun o‘quvchilar “a trousers” yoki “my jeans is old” deyishadi. Bu xato. Inglizchada trousers, jeans, shoes ko‘plik so‘zlar, “a” ham, “is” ham ularga mos kelmaydi. To‘g‘ri: a pair of trousers, my jeans are old.
scenes.say: Not: a trousers. Say: a pair of trousers. Not: my jeans is old. Say: my jeans are old.
scenes.say_uz: A trousers emas. A pair of trousers deng. My jeans is old emas. My jeans are old deng.

scenes.title: Is yoki are?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Har bir gapda bo‘sh joyga to‘g‘ri so‘zni ayting: is yoki are, to‘rtinchisida esa a yoki the. Birinchi: my jeans, ko‘k. Ikkinchi: the jacket, qora. Uchinchi: her shoes, yangi. To‘rtinchi: menga bir juft paypoq kerak. O‘ylang, juft so‘zlar ko‘plikda ekanini unutmang.
scenes.say: My jeans, is or are, blue? The jacket, is or are, black? Her shoes, is or are, new? I need, a or the, pair of socks?
scenes.say_uz: Mening jinsim, is yoki are, ko‘k? Kurtka, is yoki are, qora? Uning tuflilari, is yoki are, yangi? Menga, a yoki the, juft paypoq kerak?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 4) I need a pair of socks.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: my jeans ARE blue, chunki jeans ko‘plik. Ikkinchi: the jacket IS black, chunki kurtka bitta narsa. Uchinchi: her shoes ARE new. To‘rtinchi: I need A pair of socks, chunki “pair” sanalaveradigan so‘z, bitta juft. Uchtasini topgan bo‘lsangiz, juda yaxshi.
scenes.say: My jeans are blue. The jacket is black. Her shoes are new. I need a pair of socks.
scenes.say_uz: Mening jinsim ko‘k. Kurtka qora. Uning tuflilari yangi. Menga bir juft paypoq kerak.

scenes.title: Nima kiyib turibsiz?
scenes.say_native: Kim nima kiyib turganini aytish uchun “wearing” so‘zidan foydalanamiz: I’m wearing a blue shirt. He’s wearing black trousers. She’s wearing a red dress. Bu shakl hozirgi paytda kiyib turgan narsangizni bildiradi. Uning to‘liq qoidasini keyingi darslarda o‘rganamiz, hozircha shu tayyor qolip kifoya. O‘zbekchada “kiymoq” bitta fe’l, inglizchada esa u wear.
scenes.say: I'm wearing a blue shirt. He's wearing black trousers. She's wearing a red dress.
scenes.say_uz: Men ko‘k ko‘ylak kiyganman. U qora shim kiyib turibdi. U qizil ko‘ylak kiyib turibdi.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: qiyin so‘zlar
scenes.say_native: Bir nechta so‘zning talaffuzi qiyin. Jacket — urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda: JA-ket, “jakket” emas. Trousers — urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda va “trau” kabi o‘qiladi: TRAU-zerz, oxirida “z” jarangli. Shirt va skirt so‘zlarida unli cho‘ziq, inglizcha “er” kabi, lekin r tovushi aytilmaydi. Oxirida t aniq eshitilsin.
scenes.say: Jacket. Trousers. Shirt. Skirt. Jacket, trousers, shirt, skirt.
scenes.say_uz: Kurtka. Shim. Ko‘ylak. Yubka. Kurtka, shim, ko‘ylak, yubka.

scenes.title: This va that
scenes.say_native: Endi ko‘rsatish olmoshlari. This — bu, yoningizdagi, qo‘lingizdagi narsa. That — u, narida turgan, sizdan uzoqdagi narsa. Do‘konda kurtkani ushlab turib “this jacket” deysiz, javondagi uzoq narsaga qarab “that jacket” deysiz. Ikkalasi ham bitta narsa uchun: this jacket, that shirt. Ular ot oldidan ham, yolg‘iz ham kelaveradi: What’s this? What’s that?
scenes.say: This jacket is nice. That shirt is expensive. What's this? What's that?
scenes.say_uz: Bu kurtka chiroyli. U ko‘ylak qimmat. Bu nima? U nima?

scenes.title: These va those
scenes.say_native: Ko‘plik uchun these va those bor. These — bular, yaqin turgan bir nechta narsa. Those — ular, uzoqdagi bir nechta narsa. This ko‘plikda these bo‘ladi, that ko‘plikda those. Shim, jinsi va tufli kabi juft kiyimlarda doim these yoki those ishlatiladi: these jeans, those shoes. Fe’l ham ko‘plikda: these jeans ARE nice, those shoes ARE expensive.
scenes.say: These shoes are black. Those gloves are nice. These jeans are cheap.
scenes.say_uz: Bu tuflilar qora. U qo‘lqoplar chiroyli. Bu jinsi arzon.

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha bilan solishtirish
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida “bu” va “u” bor, ya’ni yaqin va uzoq, bu ingliz tiliga o‘xshaydi. Muhim farq: o‘zbekchada “bu” ko‘plikda ham, birlikda ham o‘zgarmaydi, “bu kitob”, “bu kitoblar”. Inglizchada esa this va these boshqa so‘zlar. Bunga o‘rganib qolish kerak. Ruscha “этот, эти” ga o‘xshaydi, shuning uchun rus tilini bilsangiz osonroq bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: This is a jacket. These are jackets. That is a coat. Those are coats.
scenes.say_uz: Bu kurtka. Bular kurtkalar. U palto. Ular paltolar.

scenes.title: This shoes — xato
scenes.say_native: Eng ko‘p uchraydigan xato: ko‘plik otga this deyish. “This shoes” noto‘g‘ri, to‘g‘risi these shoes. Xuddi shunday “that jeans” emas, those jeans. Ikkinchi xato: these bilan is ishlatish. These doim are bilan keladi: these are my shoes.
scenes.say: Not: this shoes. Say: these shoes. Not: these is my bag. Say: these are my bags.
scenes.say_uz: This shoes emas. These shoes deng. These is my bag emas. These are my bags deng.

scenes.title: Tovush farqi
scenes.say_native: Bu so‘zlar tovush jihatidan ham farq qiladi. This — qisqa “i” bilan va oxirida s: this. These — cho‘ziq “ii” bilan va oxirida jarangli z: these. Boshidagi th tovushi hamma so‘zda bir xil: tilingizni tishlaringiz orasiga qo‘yib, yengil jarangli tovush chiqarasiz, “d” yoki “z” emas. That qisqa a bilan, those esa “ou” bilan tugaydi: those.
scenes.say: This, these. That, those. This is a jacket. These are jackets.
scenes.say_uz: Bu, bular. U, ular. Bu kurtka. Bular kurtkalar.

scenes.title: This, that, these yoki those?
board: 1) A shirt in your hand: ___ shirt
2) Shoes on a shelf far away: ___ shoes
4) A coat across the room: ___ coat
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Rasmga qarab to‘g‘ri so‘zni tanlang. Birinchi: qo‘lingizdagi ko‘ylak. Ikkinchi: uzoqdagi javonda turgan tuflilar. Uchinchi: qo‘lingizdagi jinsi. To‘rtinchi: xonaning narigi chetida osilgan palto.
scenes.say: A shirt in your hand. Shoes far away. Jeans in your hand. A coat across the room.
scenes.say_uz: Qo‘lingizdagi ko‘ylak. Uzoqdagi tuflilar. Qo‘lingizdagi jinsi. Xonaning narigi chetidagi palto.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Qo‘ldagi bitta ko‘ylak: this shirt. Uzoqdagi bir nechta tufli: those shoes. Qo‘ldagi jinsi: these jeans, chunki jeans ko‘plik. Uzoqdagi bitta palto: that coat. Ikki savol: yaqinmi yoki uzoqmi, birlikmi yoki ko‘plikmi. Shu ikkisiga javob bersangiz, to‘g‘ri so‘zni topasiz.
scenes.say: This shirt. Those shoes. These jeans. That coat.
scenes.say_uz: Bu ko‘ylak. U tuflilar. Bu jinsi. U palto.

scenes.title: Narxni so‘rash
scenes.say_native: Narxni so‘rash uchun “How much” ishlatamiz. Birlikda: How much IS this jacket? Ko‘plikda: How much ARE these jeans? Javobda birlik uchun “It’s”, ko‘plik uchun “They’re” aytiladi: It’s forty-five pounds. They’re thirty pounds. Do‘konda pul birligi aytilmasa ham, narx tushuniladi.
scenes.say: How much is this jacket? It's forty-five pounds. How much are these jeans? They're thirty pounds.
scenes.say_uz: Bu kurtka qancha turadi? Qirq besh funt. Bu jinsi qancha turadi? O‘ttiz funt.

scenes.title: Narxni aytish

examples.uz: Narxi o‘n ikki funt ellik pens.

scenes.say_native: Narxni aytishda avval raqamni, keyin pul birligini ayting: forty-five pounds. Funt belgisi £ raqamdan oldin yoziladi, lekin o‘qilganda raqamdan keyin aytiladi. Agar pens ham bo‘lsa, “and” aytmasdan ham bo‘ladi: twelve pounds fifty — 12 funt 50 pens. Dollar uchun: twenty dollars. “Cheap” — arzon, “expensive” — qimmat: It’s cheap. That’s expensive.
scenes.say: Forty-five pounds. Twelve pounds fifty. Twenty dollars. It's cheap. It's expensive.
scenes.say_uz: Qirq besh funt. O‘n ikki funt ellik. Yigirma dollar. Arzon. Qimmat.

scenes.title: How much — xatolari
scenes.say_native: Narx so‘rashda ikki xato qilinadi. Birinchisi: rus tilidagi “сколько стоит” ga qarab “How much costs” deyish. Inglizchada “is” yoki “are” kerak: How much is this jacket? Ikkinchisi: “how many” bilan adashtirish. How many — sanaladigan narsalar soni uchun, masalan how many shirts. Narx uchun faqat how much. Va yana, ko‘plikda How much ARE these? deysiz.
scenes.say: Not: How much costs this? Say: How much is this? Not: How many is this? Say: How much is this?
scenes.say_uz: How much costs this emas. How much is this deng. How many is this emas. How much is this deng.

scenes.title: Narxni so‘rang
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Uchta narsaning narxini so‘rang va javob bering. Birinchi: kurtka, oltmish funt. Ikkinchi: jinsi, o‘ttiz besh funt. Uchinchi: shlyapa, sakkiz funt. Avval savolni, keyin javobni ayting, birlik yoki ko‘plikka e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: A jacket, sixty pounds. Jeans, thirty-five pounds. A hat, eight pounds.
scenes.say_uz: Kurtka, oltmish funt. Jinsi, o‘ttiz besh funt. Shlyapa, sakkiz funt.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: How much is this jacket? It's £60.
How much are these jeans? They're £35.
How much is this hat? It's £8.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Kurtka: How much is this jacket? It’s sixty pounds. Jinsi ko‘plik, shuning uchun How much ARE these jeans? They’re thirty-five pounds. Shlyapa: How much is this hat? It’s eight pounds. Savoldagi is yoki are javobdagi it’s yoki they’re bilan mos kelishi kerak.
scenes.say: How much is this jacket? It's sixty pounds. How much are these jeans? They're thirty-five pounds.
scenes.say_uz: Bu kurtka qancha turadi? Oltmish funt. Bu jinsi qancha turadi? O‘ttiz besh funt.

scenes.title: O‘lcham
board: Do you have this in a large?

examples.t: Do you have this in a small?

scenes.say_native: O‘lchamni so‘rash: What size are you? — Siz qaysi o‘lchamsiz? Javob: I’m a medium. Asosiy o‘lchamlar: small — kichik, medium — o‘rta, large — katta. Yozuvda S, M, L deb yoziladi. Boshqa o‘lcham so‘rash uchun: Do you have this in a large? — Bundan kattasi bormi? Poyabzal uchun: What size are your shoes? va javob bitta raqam, masalan size forty-two yoki UK 8.
scenes.say: What size are you? I'm a medium. Do you have this in a large?
scenes.say_uz: Siz qaysi o‘lchamsiz? Men o‘rtachaman. Buning kattasi bormi?

scenes.title: Katta, kichik, to‘g‘ri
scenes.say_native: Kiyib ko‘rgandan keyin fikringizni aytasiz. It’s too big — juda katta. It’s too small — juda kichik. It’s a bit tight — biroz tor. It’s just right — aynan o‘zi. Yoki: It fits — o‘lchami to‘g‘ri keldi. Too so‘zi “keragidan ortiq” ma’nosini beradi va u ijobiy emas. “Too nice” deyish ma’noli bo‘lmaydi. Ko‘plikda: They’re too big, they fit.
scenes.say: It's too big. They're too small. It's a bit tight. It's just right.
scenes.say_uz: U juda katta. Ular juda kichik. U biroz tor. U aynan mos.

scenes.title: Try on

examples.t: Can I try this jacket on?

scenes.say_native: Kiyib ko‘rish uchun “try on” fe’lini ishlatamiz. Bu ikki so‘zdan iborat fe’l, phrasal verb. Can I try it on? — Uni kiyib ko‘rsam bo‘ladimi? Ko‘plikda: Can I try these on? Kiyinish xonasi: the changing room, Amerikada fitting room. Where is the changing room? Muloyim bo‘lish uchun avval “Excuse me” deysiz, keyin savol berasiz.
scenes.say: Excuse me, can I try this jacket on? Where is the changing room?
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, bu kurtkani kiyib ko‘rsam bo‘ladimi? Kiyinish xonasi qayerda?

scenes.title: Try on it — xato
board: ✓ Can I try on this jacket? (ot bilan)
scenes.say_native: Phrasal verb bilan olmosh, ya’ni it, them yoki me kelsa, olmosh fe’l va qo‘shimcha o‘rtasiga tushadi: try it on, try them on. “Try on it” noto‘g‘ri. Lekin ot bilan ikki tartib ham to‘g‘ri: try on the jacket yoki try the jacket on. Qoida oddiy: olmosh bo‘lsa, o‘rtaga qo‘ying.
scenes.say: Not: try on it. Say: try it on. Say: try them on.
scenes.say_uz: Try on it emas. Try it on deng. Try them on deng.

scenes.title: Savol tuzing
board: 1) The jacket is too big. Ask for a small.
2) You want to try the jeans on.
3) Ask where the changing room is.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Uchta vaziyat. Birinchi: kurtka juda katta, sotuvchidan kichikroq o‘lcham so‘rang. Ikkinchi: jinsini kiyib ko‘rmoqchisiz, ruxsat so‘rang, olmosh to‘g‘ri joyda bo‘lsin. Uchinchi: kiyinish xonasi qayerda ekanini so‘rang. Muloyim bo‘ling.
scenes.say: The jacket is too big. You want to try the jeans on. Where is the changing room?
scenes.say_uz: Kurtka juda katta. Jinsini kiyib ko‘rmoqchisiz. Kiyinish xonasi qayerda?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Do you have this in a small?
3) Excuse me, where is the changing room?
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: Do you have this in a small? yoki It’s too big. Do you have a smaller size? Ikkinchi: Can I try them on? Jeans ko‘plik, shuning uchun them. Uchinchi: Excuse me, where is the changing room?
scenes.say: Do you have this in a small? Can I try them on? Excuse me, where is the changing room?
scenes.say_uz: Buning kichigi bormi? Ularni kiyib ko‘rsam bo‘ladimi? Kechirasiz, kiyinish xonasi qayerda?

scenes.title: Do‘kondagi iboralar
board: Can I help you? — I'm just looking.
I'll take it. / Can I pay by card?

examples.t: I'm looking for a blue shirt.

scenes.say_native: Do‘konda sotuvchi “Can I help you?” deydi, ya’ni yordam bera olamanmi? Agar shunchaki qarab turgan bo‘lsangiz: I’m just looking, thanks. Aniq narsa qidirsangiz: I’m looking for a jacket. Qaror qilsangiz: I’ll take it — olaman. To‘lov uchun: Can I pay by card? yoki Can I pay in cash? Sotuvchi pulni olganda “Here you are” deb narsani beradi, javob: Thank you.
scenes.say: Can I help you? I'm looking for a jacket. I'll take it. Can I pay by card?
scenes.say_uz: Yordam bera olamanmi? Men kurtka qidiryapman. Olaman. Karta bilan to‘lasam bo‘ladimi?

scenes.title: Dialog: kurtka sotib olish
board: B: I'm looking for a black jacket.
A: What size are you?  B: A medium.
B: Can I try it on? ... I'll take it.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi dialogni tinglang. Mijoz do‘konga kirib kurtka qidiradi. Sotuvchi rang va o‘lchamni so‘raydi, mijoz kiyib ko‘radi va narxni so‘rab, sotib oladi. Tinglab, quyidagi savollarga javob toping: u nima qidiryapti, qaysi rangda, qaysi o‘lchamda va kurtka qancha turadi.
scenes.say: Good morning. Can I help you? Yes, please. I'm looking for a jacket. What colour? Black, please. What size are you? I'm a medium. Try this one. Can I try it on? Of course. Oh, it's perfect. How much is it? It's sixty pounds. I'll take it.
scenes.say_uz: Xayrli tong. Yordam bera olamanmi? Ha, iltimos. Men kurtka qidiryapman. Qanday rangda? Qora, iltimos. Qaysi o‘lcham? O‘rta. Buni kiying. Kiyib ko‘rsam bo‘ladimi? Albatta. Ajoyib. Qancha turadi? Oltmish funt. Olaman.

scenes.title: Tushundingizmi?
scenes.say_native: Endi dialog bo‘yicha to‘rtta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: mijoz nima qidiryapti? Ikkinchi: kurtka qanday rangda? Uchinchi: uning o‘lchami qanday? To‘rtinchi: kurtka qancha turadi? Javobni inglizcha to‘liq gap bilan aytishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: What is he looking for? What colour is it? What size is he? How much is it?
scenes.say_uz: U nima qidiryapti? U qanday rangda? Uning o‘lchami qanday? U qancha turadi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: u kurtka qidiryapti, a jacket. Ikkinchi: kurtka qora, black. Uchinchi: uning o‘lchami o‘rta, a medium. To‘rtinchi: narxi oltmish funt, sixty pounds. Agar tushunmagan bo‘lsangiz, dialogni yana bir marta tinglang va faqat ranglar, o‘lcham va narxga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: He is looking for a jacket. It is black. He is a medium. It is sixty pounds.
scenes.say_uz: U kurtka qidiryapti. U qora. U o‘rta o‘lchamda. U oltmish funt.

scenes.title: Dialog: jinsi juda katta
board: A: These jeans are too big.
B: Do you have them in a smaller size?
A: Here you are. Can I try them on?
A: I'll take them. Can I pay by card?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Mijoz jinsini kiyib ko‘rdi, lekin u juda katta chiqdi. U sotuvchidan kichikroq o‘lcham so‘raydi. Eshitganlaringizdan javob toping: muammo nima edi, yangi o‘lcham qanday, jinsi qancha turadi va mijoz qanday to‘laydi. Ko‘plik shakllariga, ya’ni them va they’re ga e’tibor bering.
scenes.say: Excuse me. These jeans are too big. Do you have them in a smaller size? Yes. Here you are, a small. Can I try them on? Of course. They fit! How much are they? They're thirty-five pounds. I'll take them. Can I pay by card? Yes, of course.
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz. Bu jinsi juda katta. Ularning kichikroq o‘lchami bormi? Ha. Marhamat, kichik. Kiyib ko‘rsam bo‘ladimi? Albatta. To‘g‘ri keldi! Qancha turadi? O‘ttiz besh funt. Olaman. Karta bilan to‘lasam bo‘ladimi? Ha, albatta.

scenes.title: Savollarga javob bering
board: 2) What size is the new pair?
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog bo‘yicha savollar. Birinchi: muammo nima edi? Ikkinchi: yangi jinsi qaysi o‘lchamda? Uchinchi: jinsi qancha turadi? To‘rtinchi: mijoz qanday to‘laydi, naqd pulmi yoki kartami? Javoblaringizni qisqa va aniq ayting.
scenes.say: What is the problem? What size is the new pair? How much are they? How does he pay?
scenes.say_uz: Muammo nima? Yangi jinsi qaysi o‘lchamda? U qancha turadi? U qanday to‘laydi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: jinsi juda katta edi, the jeans are too big. Ikkinchi: yangi o‘lcham kichik, a small. Uchinchi: narxi o‘ttiz besh funt, thirty-five pounds. To‘rtinchi: u karta bilan to‘laydi, by card. Eslab qoling, to‘lov usulini “by card” deymiz, “with card” emas. Naqd uchun: in cash.
scenes.say: The jeans are too big. A small. Thirty-five pounds. By card.
scenes.say_uz: Jinsi juda katta. Kichik o‘lcham. O‘ttiz besh funt. Karta bilan.

scenes.title: Tabiiy nutq: bog‘lanish
scenes.say_native: Tabiiy nutqda so‘zlar bir-biriga bog‘lanadi. Can I try it on? savolida can kuchsiz aytiladi, deyarli “kn” kabi, va “try it on” yagona so‘zdek eshitiladi: tri-it-on, bunda ‘it’ dagi t oldingi so‘zga yopishadi. Do you have this? esa “dyu hev” kabi yengil aytiladi. Shuning uchun inglizlarni tushunish qiyin tuyuladi.
scenes.say: Can I try it on? Can I try them on? Do you have this in a medium?
scenes.say_uz: Kiyib ko‘rsam bo‘ladimi? Ularni kiyib ko‘rsam bo‘ladimi? Buning o‘rta o‘lchami bormi?

scenes.title: Siz nima kiyib turibsiz?
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq, ikki qismdan iborat. Birinchisi: o‘zingiz kiyib turgan narsalarni kamida uchta jumla bilan ayting, ranglarini qo‘shing: I’m wearing a… Ikkinchisi: kurtka sotib olish bo‘yicha rolli o‘yin. Siz mijozsiz, savol bering: o‘lcham, kiyib ko‘rish, narx. Hozir ovoz chiqarib bajaring.
scenes.say: Now it is your turn. Tell me what you are wearing. Then buy a jacket. Ask about the size, try it on, and ask the price.
scenes.say_uz: Endi navbat sizda. Nima kiyib turganingizni ayting. Keyin kurtka sotib oling. O‘lcham haqida so‘rang, kiyib ko‘ring va narxini so‘rang.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: I'm wearing a white shirt and blue jeans.
Excuse me, do you have this jacket in a medium?
Can I try it on? How much is it? I'll take it.
scenes.say_native: Mana namuna. Men oq ko‘ylak va ko‘k jinsi kiyib turibman: I’m wearing a white shirt and blue jeans. Xarid: Excuse me, do you have this jacket in a medium? Can I try it on? It’s great. How much is it? I’ll take it.
scenes.say: I'm wearing a white shirt and blue jeans. Do you have this jacket in a medium? Can I try it on? How much is it? I'll take it.
scenes.say_uz: Men oq ko‘ylak va ko‘k jinsi kiyganman. Bu kurtkaning o‘rta o‘lchami bormi? Kiyib ko‘rsam bo‘ladimi? Qancha turadi? Olaman.

scenes.title: Darsni yakunlaymiz
board: trousers / jeans = plural: a pair of
try it on • How much is / are ...?
scenes.say_native: Bugun nimalarni o‘rgandik, qisqacha takrorlaymiz. Rang otdan oldin turadi va s olmaydi: a red jacket. Trousers, jeans, shoes ko‘plikda: a pair of, my jeans are. This va that bitta narsa uchun, these va those bir nechta narsa uchun. Narx: how much is, how much are. O‘lcham: what size. Kiyib ko‘rish: try it on, olmosh o‘rtada. Juda yaxshi ishladingiz!
scenes.say: Colour comes before the noun. Jeans are plural. This and that, these and those. Can I try it on? How much is it?
scenes.say_uz: Rang otdan oldin keladi. Jinsi ko‘plik. Bu va u, bular va ular. Kiyib ko‘rsam bo‘ladimi? Qancha turadi?

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Say what you are wearing (4+ sentences)
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi. Birinchi: o‘zingiz kiyib turgan narsalarni kamida to‘rtta jumla bilan ayting yoki yozing, har birida rang bo‘lsin. Ikkinchi: kurtka sotib olish bo‘yicha sakkiz qatorli dialog tuzing, unda o‘lcham, kiyib ko‘rish va narx bo‘lsin. Tekshiring: rang otdan oldin turibdimi, jeans bilan are ishlatilganmi, try it on to‘g‘rimi. Keyingi darsda so‘roq gaplar tuzishni o‘rganamiz. Ko‘rishguncha!
scenes.say: Describe your clothes and write a shopping dialogue. See you next time. Bye!
scenes.say_uz: Kiyimlaringizni tasvirlang va xarid dialogini yozing. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz. Xayr!

homework_uz: O‘zingiz kiyib turgan narsalarni kamida to‘rtta jumla bilan tasvirlang (har birida rang bo‘lsin) va kurtka sotib olish bo‘yicha sakkiz qatorli dialog yozing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: rang otdan oldin turibdi, jeans bilan are ishlatilgan, o‘lcham, try it on va narx dialogda bor.
